title: Say which Git range a release covers
statement: As a developer, I can say which tags or commits a release runs between, so everything that depends on what changed is worked out from Git and not from memory.
overview: A tag is usually created late in a release, so the range has to tolerate naming one that does not exist yet. Until then, the end can be a branch.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A release can record a start and an end, each a tag, branch or commit, as given.
Either can be changed at any time with an explicit command.
An end that does not resolve yet, such as a tag not yet pushed, is reported as unresolved, and nothing is computed from it.
A release with no range is valid, and only the commands that need one say so.
